title: Twente application submitted
summary: Dotlocal reports that an application for the .TWENTE geographic new gTLD has been submitted as part of the 2026 ICANN New gTLD Program.

title: Update on the .FURRY new gTLD
summary: The gTLD Club reports a new set of publicly announced 2026 Round applications, including .FURRY and a number of other newly disclosed strings.

title: New applicant announcements: .CHESS, .HUMAN and .AGENT
summary: The gTLD Club's September 9 update lists newly announced applications including .CHESS, .HUMAN and .AGENT, alongside larger portfolios disclosed by other applicants.

title: Vant Nexus applies for .PORTAL, .ISLAND and .TRUCK
summary: Vant Nexus Technologies LLC announced applications for the three new gTLD strings .PORTAL, .ISLAND and .TRUCK.

title: ShortDot announces 80 new gTLD applications
summary: The gTLD Club's September roundup reports that ShortDot submitted 80 new gTLD applications, with most of the announced strings consisting of three letters.

title: Radix Registry announces 46 strings
summary: The September 9 gTLD Club roundup reports that Radix Registry announced 46 strings in connection with its 2026 Round applications.
